services.name: Dune Cabin
services.desc: Each cabin is fully furnished and designed for your comfort in mind. Plush bedding, a full bathroom and shower, kitchenette, high speed Wi-Fi, and cable TV make for a cozy stay, while bay views, picnic tables and personal fire rings extend the cabin experience into the outdoor spaces. All accommodations include plenty of room to roam around our sandy bayfront, indoor/outdoor lounges, and access to our sunlit saltwater pool, fitness center, and clubhouse amenities. Meet the NEWEST ADDITION to the Bay Point Cabin family, the Waterfront Breakwater. With a spacious floor plan and fresh design, this is a blend of our 2 favorites, the Timber Haus and Drift Cabins.
